lines.t: Embrace only that which is good
Send down from above as it should
The Father in heaven lights the way
His love and spirit guide each day
For every gift that he sends is true
Spirit and truth shining through
If you listen, if you choose to obey
He'll lead you gently on His way
For God is love
His mercy reigns from high above
Let spirit and truth flow through all you say and do
Walk in His ways
Hear now His voice
Let go of all that weighs you down Take up his peace, lay aside your crown
His grace descends on every heart
United as one, never to part
Follow His teaching, hold fast to His word
Let all of heaven's truth be heard
As you are led, so choose to lead
So live in hope with every deed
For God is love, His mercy reigns from high above
Let spirit and truth flow through all you say and do
Walk in His ways, hear now His voice, led by His hand
If you so choose, rejoice
Do not worry if you lack every answer
Spirit will guide through every dancer
For those who walk in spirit and light
Shall find their peace, their joy, their sight
For God is love
His spirit calls from up above
Obey His voice
Walk in His way
Embrace only good, let his love remain
Thank you.
